confounds_reason: Not a width proxy. Over six locally run models lid_mean is [11.541, 12.881, 18.623, 20.356, 11.797, 11.349] with Spearman rho(d_model) = -0.030, rho(params) = -0.143, rho(n_layers) = -0.647 and rho(vocab) = +0.926 -- the vocab figure is an artifact of a near-binary predictor (49152/50257/50304) on n=6 and should not be read as a confound. The decisive architectural intervention refutes a mechanical ambient-dimension term outright: zero-padding the gpt2 cloud 768 -> 1536 leaves lid_mean bit-identical (11.541451210234994 both). The residual n_layers association is more plausibly a family effect: the two Pythia models are the two highest (18.62, 20.36) and the four GPT-2/SmolLM2 models cluster at 11.3-12.9. SUSPECTED rather than NONE because n=6 with four distinct widths cannot separate family from depth, and the older 66-model archive that earlier rounds cited (rho(d_model)=+0.502) used a different protocol (num_samples=200, layerwise=true) and should be re-measured under the shipped 20/50/false config before being used as evidence.
